summary: Extract monochrome nonzero 4-connected components and sort them by numeric color, using size as the secondary order only if colors repeat. Build an n-by-n matrix for n components. Put zero on the diagonal and whenever the compared components have equal areas; otherwise put the numeric color of the component with larger area. Component positions and shapes are irrelevant beyond connectivity, color, and cell count.
